real_world_source.name: LeRobot ALOHA mobile cabinet logged joint setpoints and measured state
real_world_source.action_semantics: 14 published logged joint-position action targets, same 50Hz frame; exact actuator response/latency and intervention identifiability unverified

protocol.role: FIT-only internal point-forecast development, not independent qualification
protocol.fit_episodes: original FIT episode 0-48 only, 49 real episodes
protocol.internal_report_episodes: original FIT episode 49-58 only, 10 real episodes; separate within-FIT heldout; historical source exposed to earlier training, not independent source qualification
protocol.original_dev_episodes: original old DEV episode 59-71 remains unopened by this study
protocol.protected_test_episodes: original TEST >=72 remains unopened by this study
protocol.target: measured 14-joint state[t+1] from genuine logged state[t], action[t] target and source history of action[t-1]
protocol.action_scope: observational conditional-on-logged-setpoint, never do(action), torque law, motor policy or safety controller
protocol.sampling: Uniform fit episode index 0-48 and valid t index 32..1498 with replacement, fixed per-seed saved schedule
protocol.training_exposure: 2,048 real sampled FIT origins per model, 65,536 original observation context presentations per model
protocol.optimizer: AdamW lr0.0006, weight decay0.001, clipped gradient norm1
protocol.loss: mean squared state-delta error standardized by FIT-only per-joint RMS transition
protocol.preprocessing: FIT 49 episodes only, source state/action mean/std, delta RMS, original chronological frame/episode IDs
references: FIT-only channelwise servo gain x_t+g(u_t-x_t), gain in [0,1]
protocol.report_metric: all14 joint mean-square error and mean-absolute error; each joint and movement-rich strata separately
protocol.report_schedule: every 8th eligible measured FIT holdout transition from t>=32 and t+1 in same source episode
protocol.movement_threshold: 90th quantile FIT-only per-sample average squared standardized step
protocol.full_capability_gate: every seed average MSE <= 95% of strongest FIXED FIT-only practical reference and moving MSE <= reference; internal report only, no independent score qualification
protocol.comparison_claim: not a matched learned architecture comparison; source-factual pilot versus practical deterministic references
protocol.confidence: episode-cluster paired bootstrap on 10 actual holdout episodes, descriptive and conditional on five trained models
protocol.stop_rule: one five-seed FIT-only fit, all originals freeze, one internal source holdout score, no changed gates/restarts/favorable-seed selection/DEV or protected TEST
